title: Evaluate Chunk Length Against Compounding Error
summary: Open-loop action errors accumulate until feedback corrects them.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Error channels are normalized dimensionless position increments; all channels are equally weighted, not mixed raw meters and radians.

physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Rows are equally spaced control steps. The toy reset represents perfect feedback at each chunk boundary.

provenance.authoring_notes: Original diagnostic inspired by ACT compounding-error motivation. It evaluates supplied residuals in a unit-gain integrator; it does not predict ACT rollout performance or claim an optimal chunk length.
